method: Direct visual inspection of the two final raster images, supplementing archived PDF coordinate and reopened DOCX assertions.

observations.docx-leading-inline-column-break: Left text remains in the first column; right text starts in the second column with its follower directly below. All three labels are legible and unclipped.
observations.docx-midparagraph-inline-column-break: Bold text retains the first-line indent in the first column. Italic continuation starts in the second column, with the regular follower below. All labels are legible and unclipped.

limits: Visual review does not independently establish exact vertical paragraph margins or exhaustive multiline keep-together pagination.
Rendering uses the pinned LibreOfficeDev build recorded in the receipt, not live Microsoft Word.
